name: Envision Greenwise Holdings Limited
summary: Envision Greenwise Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the construction business in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. It operates through Superstructure Building and RMAA Works Service; and Reverse Supply Chain Management and Environmental-Related Service segments.
